adds.title: Supreme Federal Court challenge to Novo Gama bathroom law - Justice Cármen Lúcia order
adds.summary: Novo Gama, Goiás enacted a municipal law prohibiting trans people from using bathrooms and STF Minister Cármen Lúcia ordered the city to explain and justify the law under constitutional challenge.

adds.title: Goianira court and Court of Justice of Goiás decisions - Kali Julie Dias case
adds.summary: In Goianira, Goiás, non-binary person Kali Julie Dias won the right to alter the gender marker on official identity documents to reflect non-binary identity.

adds.title: Supreme Court injunction 20 February 2020 and STF plenary vote 25 April - Novo Gama 'gender ideology' teaching ban
adds.summary: On 25 April 2020 the STF plenary unanimously struck down Novo Gama (GO) Law 1.516/2015 that banned gender-diversity content and references to gender ideology in municipal schools and required prior vetting of all teaching materials, holding it usurped the Union's exclusive competence over national education bases and violated gender equality, plural and democratic education, and state secularism, following the May 2017 MPF challenge and a prior suspending injunction by Minister Alexandre de Moraes.
